description: Use this when the host asks for an interview's public link (anyone with the link can join): its address, whether it is on, how many have joined, the join limit and when it expires. Do not use this to build or guess an address, to find a person's personal interview link (list_participants shows those), or to share a meeting link or calendar invitation. It changes nothing and returns the address exactly as the app gives it; never build one from the interview's id. The state says whether it is taking people right now (Accepting) or why not (Off, Paused, No credits, Full, Expired).

interview_id.description: The interview's id, exactly as list_interviews or create_interview returned it in its structured data. It is for tool calls only: never show it to the host; name the interview by its title. Do not guess an id, and do not send a title or an email address in its place: if you do not have the id, call list_interviews.

name: get_open_link
